content:
The highly anticipated 《Ted Lasso》（Chinese tentative title《足球教練泰迪》）has finally returned, with the first episode of the fourth season now available on Apple TV.

Ted Lasso 終於回歸

After more than three years since the end of the third season, the series has finally met viewers again, with the first episode of the fourth season now available for streaming on Apple TV.

Apple is heavily promoting the return of the new season this time. In addition to arranging Jason Sudeikis and Brendan Hunt to make a surprise appearance as Coach Ted and Coach Beard during the World Cup final, they will also hold a lookalike competition at the Apple Fifth Avenue Plaza in New York this Thursday (August 6).

If you haven't seen any spoilers about the new season so far and wish to keep it that way, I suggest you go watch the first episode right away. But if you don't mind knowing the general direction of the new season in advance, here is the series synopsis provided by Apple TV:

《Ted Lasso》Season 4 has a total of 10 episodes, airing until October 7, 2026, and is expected to be the first of three new seasons.

Most of the main cast will return, with new additions including Tanya Reynolds (who appeared in 《Underdogs》) and Paloma Cinco (who appeared in 《De La Cruz》). She is the biological sister of Cristo Fernandez, who plays the beloved Dani Rojas in the series and is now a professional football player.
